intro:
Bad boys don't play by the rules.
Break down their walls and find out what's underneath the dark side.
description:
Somewhere off the map, the villains operate. Crime bosses, con artists, masterminds, rebels, hackers, every kind of dangerous man you can imagine, each one has carved out his own version of power, and none of them are waiting to be saved.

Each one is dangerous in his own way. Cold-blooded strategists, magnetic charmers, chaos-loving wildcards, quiet operators hiding more than they let on.

• There's the boss who rules through fear but softens under real attention.
• The trickster who tests you just to see if you'll flinch.
• The enforcer who respects strength more than sweetness.
Each one wants something different, and figuring out what could be the difference between winning him over and losing him for good.


Features:

♥ A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE VILLAINS: Every character brings his own brand of danger, and no two are alike.

♥ DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: What you say decides who opens up to you and who shuts you out for good.

♥ CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build trust with each villain to unlock dates and intimate moments only he'll share with you.

♥ EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Every bond deepened means a new illustration unlocked, some hidden until you've truly earned them.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every villain falls for you. Some routes end in romance, others end somewhere far more dangerous.

♥ 30 DAYS TO WIN THEIR DARK HEARTS: The clock is running. Waste a day and a path could close forever.


You've got thirty days to prove you're not afraid of the dark.

Are you villain enough for them?
